title: The weighted fibre sum (rotational flux density) equals m·t near (1, 0)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ), with ∂C = 0 and a cone (IsConeCurrent C). Let Q be a 2-dimensional linear subspace of ℝ^P, a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0, δ > 0 and k ∈ ℕ with k ≥ 1. Assume a ∈ spt C and that for all t > 0 and φ ∈ (0, δ) the point y := t(cos φ·a + sin φ·e) satisfies HasMassDensity C y k and spt C ∩ B_r(y) ⊆ Q for some r > 0. Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity representation of C, μ := R.measure, m ∈ ℕ with HasMassDensity C a m, and 0 < s ≤ 1/4 such that the localization property Loc(s) holds: for every s' ∈ (0, s] and every x ∈ spt C with ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s', |f(x)| < s' and |x − πx| ≤ 2s|x| one has |x − πx| < (s'/4)|x| and |x − a| < 3s' (π := Q.starProjection, f(x) := arctan(⟨x, e⟩/⟨x, a⟩)). Let T_x := approxTangentPlane 2 M x, Ax := ⟨x, a⟩e − ⟨x, e⟩a, w(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|, Z_s := {x : ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s, |f(x)| < s, |x − πx| < s|x|}, F̃(x) := (|x|, f(x)) and H(p) := Σ_{x ∈ M ∩ Z_s ∩ F̃⁻¹{p}} θ(x)·w(x) ∈ [0, ∞] for p ∈ ℝ × ℝ. Then there is s₂ > 0 such that H(p) = m·p_1 (as ENNReal.ofReal (m·p_1)) for Lebesgue-almost every p = (p_1, p_2) ∈ (1 − s₂, 1 + s₂) × (−s₂, s₂).
